source: ann-benchmarks.com public datasets (Aumüller, Bernhardsson & Faithfull, 2020), HDF5 format

sift-128-euclidean.hdf5.neighbors: 100 exact nearest neighbours per test query (ground truth shipped in file)
sift-128-euclidean.hdf5.origin: SIFT1M descriptors, Jégou, Douze & Schmid (2011), TEXMEX corpus (INRIA)

glove-100-angular.hdf5.neighbors: 100 exact nearest neighbours per test query (ground truth shipped in file)
glove-100-angular.hdf5.distance: angular (cosine); vectors are L2-normalised in benchmark.py so inner product equals cosine
glove-100-angular.hdf5.origin: GloVe word vectors, Pennington, Socher & Manning (2014), Stanford NLP; glove.twitter.27B 100d

licence: ann-benchmarks: MIT (tool); SIFT1M: free for research use (INRIA TEXMEX); GloVe: Public Domain Dedication and License v1.0 (ODC-PDDL)
note: Files are not committed (1 GB); benchmark.py expects them in this folder. Re-download from the URLs above.
